name: Tacrolimus
literature_note: 23-membered macrolide lactone (IUPAC: 1,14-oxa-azabicyclo[19.3.1]pentacosane core with fused pipecolate ring)

name: Lorlatinib
literature_note: 12-membered bridged kinase macrocycle (excluding fused pyrazole ring atoms) or 15-membered envelope

name: Vancomycin
literature_note: Tricyclic heptapeptide core with crosslinked aromatic ether/biphenyl rings forming 16-membered and 12-membered rings
